title: Plan
description: A plan: the slices that make one piece of work, each with its title, in a YAML file under docs/plans/. Forge's workflow plan writes it from a committed design, or the owner writes it by hand. Nobody edits the table of slices or the waves: forge.waves works them out from this file.

title.description: What the plan builds, in a few words the owner reads first.

requirements.description: The requirements file the plan was cut from, such as docs/requirements/todo.yaml. Named, forge.waves checks that every condition of it is met by a slice, and that a slice meets only conditions it holds.

design.description: The design file the plan was cut from, such as docs/designs/todo/design.yaml. Named, forge.waves checks that each slice names its interface files among those the design committed, keeps to one module of the design or says why, and meets a condition unless it is of kind interface or capability.

slices.description: The slices, in the order a reader takes them. The order of work comes from each slice's after, never from this order. A slice that is merged stays here: a plan is a record.

oneAfterAnotherBecause.description: Why no other order exists, in one sentence, when every slice waits for the one before. Left out, such a plan is sent back, since slices that wait for each other cannot run side by side.

plannedSlice.description: One slice of the plan: the slice as proof@1 judges it, and the title only a plan gives it.

title.description: What the slice delivers that can be seen working on its own, in one sentence the owner reads.

meets.description: The conditions of the plan's requirements this slice makes true, by id.

interface.description: The interface files the slice builds against, from the design's commit: its design file and the schema files of the actions it serves or calls. They are fixed files: no slice before it may change them.

crossesModulesBecause.description: Why the slice must reach more than one module of the design, in one sentence. Left out, a slice that reaches two modules is sent back.
